tasks.requirements: Allow operators to disable the soft phase time budget explicitly, including on resume. Disabled budgets must wait for normal provider completion without sending budget steering. Persist the disabled choice in checkpoints. Preserve defaults and positive finite numeric budgets, and reject invalid inputs before invoking a provider. The public CLI flag is --no-soft-phase-budget; retain --soft-phase-budget-seconds for positive finite numbers. Null/None in a persisted soft_phase_budget_seconds field means disabled. run_phase(..., soft_phase_budget_seconds=None) must support disabled execution. BONAPARTE_SOFT_PHASE_BUDGET=off disables the default; a positive numeric --soft-phase-budget-seconds overrides that environment setting. The two CLI budget flags are mutually exclusive. Allowed production paths: bonaparte, bonaparte_checkpoint.py. New regular root *.py helper modules are allowed; do not shadow Python standard-library or test-framework modules.

tasks.requirements: Add installed-version status and explicit atomic self-update for the launcher. Stable tags determine latest availability; offline status must be truthful. Activate only a complete validated release snapshot. A moved tag, invalid required path or failing smoke check must leave the current release usable and clean staging. Ordinary status/check behavior must not silently install a release. The user-facing commands are bonaparte status and bonaparte update. Status prints three lines: installed: <release-id>, latest: <stable-tag or unavailable>, and current: yes|no. Stable tags follow vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Preserve the existing install layout and launcher invocation. When latest cannot be resolved, status prints latest: unavailable and current: unknown and exits nonzero without changing installed state. Allowed production paths: bonaparte-launcher, workflows/scope.md. New regular root *.py helper modules are allowed; do not shadow Python standard-library or test-framework modules.
dependencies: Python >=3.11 (historical tests use starred with contexts)
